analyzed (log only, no zoo change) mw4c/mw4d [[4,1]] and mw5a [[5,2]] from Thms 5.3(i)-(ii): explicit non-CSS full-support counterexamples to the quantum extension property. All three certified by the enumeration route (algebra dim 7, 7, 5) and INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- tools/check_stabilizer_witness.py PASS on all three, and strict_cross_check consistent in equality mode (|monomial|/|perm image| = |strict|: 32/4 = 8, 32/4 = 8, 32/8 = 4). Strict transversal group orders 8, 8, 4 with logical group orders 2, 2, 4. The [[4,1]] pair C = <IIXX,XXIX,ZZXI> and D = <XXII,YYIX,ZZXI> have IDENTICAL strict invariants, so this engine does not separate them -- consistent with the paper's statement that they are monomially equivalent even though the isometry f extends to no monomial map. Not published: neither k=1 code reaches the full order-6 Sp(2,2) logical group the k=1 section requires, and both are distance 1. axis_frame_group exhaustive at levels 3 and 4 (3^n frames): 49 nontrivial frames, max kernel 3 generators, all complete for both [[4,1]] codes; 83 frames, max 4, all complete for mw5a -- level 3 and level 4 agree exactly on every code, so no frame carries a level-4-only gate. Deferred by the 3-code daily cap: the [[5,2]] partner S_B and the [[6,3]] pair of Thm 5.3(iii), and the [[3,1]] canonical pair of Thm 1.1
